title: Aftermath Finance — Integer Underflow in Perp Fee Calculation Drains ~$1.14M
root_cause: Integer Underflow / Business Logic Flaw — `integrator_taker_fees` calculation underflows to `≈ u256::MAX` when an integrator sets `max_taker_fee = 0`, causing the protocol to credit astronomically large fees to the attacker-controlled integrator account
